repairs.cause: The search UI was never actually opened — the agent typed "Malbun" into a non-search element and then looked for Directions/Share/Marker on a place panel that only appears after a location is selected via search, so the 'Marker' control never existed.
The replay worker crashed before dispatching any action, so nothing was executed and no screen could be captured (empty element list); the failure is infrastructural, not a task-logic error.

The full string "Malbun, Liechtenstein" doesn't match OsmAnd's offline search index (comma-separated "place, country" queries aren't supported); only the country entry "Liechtenstein" (5811 mi away) matched, indicating the local map data for the area is missing, so no result for Malbun was ever found.
